Haffey, Getty Images) Nelly Korda and her caddie, Jason McDede, jump into Poppie's Pond at Memorial Park Golf Course after winning The Chevron Championship 2026 in Houston on April 26, 2026. (Chris Trotman, Getty Images) Nelly Korda poses with the trophy after putting in to win on the 18th hole during the final round of the KPMG Women's PGA Championship at Atlanta Athletic Club in Johns Creek, Georgia on June 27, 2021. (Kevin C. Cox, Getty Images) Nelly Korda, right, and her sister Jessica Korda have fun posing with the trophy after Nelly won the Meijer LPGA Classic at Blythefield Country Club in Grand Rapids, Michigan on June 20, 2021. (Suhaimi Abdullah, Getty Images) Nelly Korda poses with the winner's trophy after winning the LPGA Tour-sanctioned Women's Australian Open golf championship at the Grange Golf Club in Adelaide on Feb. 17, 2019.
